description: This PHP class 'UsersSend' is a controller in the Goteo project that handles sending various email notifications to project owners, consultants, investors, and other stakeholders based on different event types and templates. It manages template selection, variable substitution, and email dispatching, including functionalities for bulk sending and personalized messages.

classes.name: UsersSend
classes.description: A controller class responsible for managing the sending of email notifications related to project events, milestones, and updates within the Goteo crowdfunding platform.

methods.name: setURL
methods.description: Sets the base URL used in templates for links.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Retrieves the base URL used in email templates.

methods.name: setConsultants
methods.description: Sets the default array of consultants for the project.

methods.name: toOwner
methods.description: Sends a personalized email to the project owner based on a specific event type.

methods.name: toConsultants
methods.description: Sends emails to project consultants or advisors based on a specific event type.

methods.name: toInvestors
methods.description: Sends notifications to investors, including updates or milestones related to the project.

methods.name: toFriends
methods.description: Deprecated method for notifying reward recipients; sends emails to individuals expecting rewards.
